entries.name: Counter
entries.full: Counter type. Counterattack when attacked from within range.

entries.name: Guard
entries.full: Defense type. Reduces damage from normal physical attacks.

entries.name: Riposte
entries.full: Counter type. Counter damage rises by Skill Lv x 5%.

entries.name: Preempt
entries.full: Counter type. When hit by a physical attack from within range, Skill Lv x 20% chance to strike first. Ineffective against special attacks.

entries.name: Preempt+
entries.full_translation: Counter type. Strike first when hit by a physical attack in range.
entries.full: Counter type. Strike first when hit by a physical attack from within range. Ineffective against special attacks.

entries.name: Block
entries.full: Counter type. Negates normal physical attacks with a Skill Lv x 7% chance.

entries.name: Iron Wall
entries.full: Defense type. Damage reduction rises by Skill Lv x 5%.

entries.name: Dodge
entries.full: Defense type. Evasion against throws, bows, and guns rises by Skill Lv x 5%.

entries.name: Agility
entries.full: Defense type. Evasion against all direct attacks rises by Skill Lv x 5%.

entries.name: Magic Resist
entries.full: Guard type. Reduces summon damage by Skill Lv x 8%. Physical damage received is the same as Guard.

entries.name: Mana Guard
entries.full: Guard type. Summon damage may be received as MP damage. Physical damage received is the same as Guard.

entries.name: Retort
entries.full: Counter type. Always counterattack when attacked from within range. Damage dealt is the same as Counter.

entries.name: P. Barrier
entries.full: Guard type. Physical damage reduction increases by Skill Lv x 10%.

entries.name: Intimidate
entries.full: Guard type. Wait with a specially shaped ZOC. Damage received is the same as Guard.

entries.name: Provoke
entries.full: Counter type. More likely to be targeted by enemies. Damage dealt is the same as Counter.

entries.name: Cover
entries.full: Guard type. Take attacks in place of adjacent allies. Damage received is the same as Guard.

entries.name: Brace
entries.full: Guard type. Skill Lv x 7% chance to nullify normal physical attacks. Otherwise damage received is the same as Guard.

entries.name: Reflect
entries.full: Guard type. Return half the damage that would be received from thrown weapons, bows and guns to the attacker. Other physical damage received is the same as Guard.
